verdict_one_line: Remaining collapse is template-family-level and prior-art-exposure-level, not subject- or lexical-level; it is acceptable to freeze Stage-1 GENERATION (more generators are NOT required and would not fix it) provided the already-queued selection-integrity lanes execute before the Stage-2 200-cut.
more_generators_reasoning: EVIDENCE: subject crowding is diluted (SAM 34-35% at w1 audit -> 9.6% at 934 -> 7.1% at 1220 by this audit's independent instrument), 156 distinct clusters with max cell 1.1%, 15 generator territories with near-uniform shard sizes (69-102). The residual collapse lives in (a) cross-shard epistemic-move template families and (b) unverified novelty on 1220/1220 records. Neither is curable by generation volume: new shards would add members to the same move families (the cheap-predictor family DOUBLED 7->14 across w2->w3 audits despite a per-shard cap, proving generation pressure feeds template growth), while the cure - judge-time merges, Stage-2 slot caps, GATE-8 triage - is selection-side and already queued with owners by the diversity_audit_w3 decision. The w3 capacity consensus (3/3 auditors, realized by w5: 1220 >= 1000) independently concluded generation is no longer the bottleneck. A FAIL verdict demanding more generators would move the portfolio AWAY from the freeze condition.
